content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints two alternative essential qualifications for the single Project Assistant - Technical post.

rows.essential_qualification: Technical Diploma (3 years duration) or Graduate Degree in appropriate discipline with 3 years relevant work experience in relevant field; OR ITI (2 years duration) in relevant trade with 8 years relevant work experience
rows.desirable: Experience in fracturing and drilling fluid handling for oil & gas applications; minimum 3 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 35,500 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice adds that HRA is as applicable. The assignment lasts 12 months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical
content_sections.text: The notice says applications are invited online. It does not name the application portal address. The application fee is printed as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates. The notice also states that the application fee shall be deposited through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc. into this account: Bank name: State Bank of India (00202) Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302 Name of bank A/C: IIT SRIC-OM Account Account No.: 39502115210 IFSC code: SBIN0000202 SWIFT code: SBININBB339 The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview call. Candidates who meet the minimum qualifications and experience are not automatically called for the interview. The notice does not give an interview date or describe the stages further.

rows.details: Online application for Project Assistant - Technical

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant - Technical posts are there?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 post of Project Assistant - Technical in the Deysarkar Centre of Petroleum and Energy Transition.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Technical Diploma (3 years duration) or Graduate Degree in appropriate discipline with 3 years relevant work experience in relevant field, or ITI (2 years duration) in relevant trade with 8 years relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Assistant - Technical?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 35,500 per month, depending on qualification and experience, with HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice prints the fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The post is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project.

faq.question: Q8. Does meeting the qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who is funding the project?
faq.answer: The sponsoring agency is SNF Flopam India Pvt. Ltd, and the PI/Co-PI is Prof./Dr. Sandeep D Kulkarni.
